risk_summary: The disclosure is materially quantified and identifies concrete impacts from COVID-19, currency depreciation, shipment delays, crop shortfalls, and increased uncommitted inventory. Its tone remains generally confident and shareholder-oriented, with substantial reliance on reassuring and forward-looking language despite uncertainty about the duration and magnitude of pandemic-related effects.
